Incineroar's intimidate and fake out support plus Garchomp's speed and power seem like strong picks to lead with.

Tyranitar is down. Mega Garchomp (sand immune, outspeeds everything here) is my main sweeper. Metagross (Steel/Psychic) takes 2x from Earthquake, so Earthquake is the pick. Remaining opponent: one of Dragonite, Rotom-Wash, Weavile, or Incineroar. Weavile is the fast threat. Dragonite and Rotom-Wash are special-leaning, so Gholdengo is the backup. Incineroar can switch in and Parting Shot if I need to pivot.
decisions.hidden_reasoning: Metagross is weak to Ground, so Earthquake from Mega Garchomp hits for double effectiveness, further boosted by Sand Force in sandstorm. With Garchomp's high Attack outspeeding Metagross, this could deal massive damage, possibly close to a OHKO despite Metagross's solid bulk.

Tyranitar and Metagross are down. Opponent has Dragonite (possible Multiscale, so the first hit at full HP is halved), Rotom-Wash, Weavile, and Incineroar left. Mega Garchomp outspeeds everything here. Earthquake does nothing to Dragonite (Flying), so I'm using Dragon Claw, which is 2x and 100% accurate. Watch for Dragonite's Multiscale wearing off and for Weavile or Rotom-Wash switching in. Gholdengo is the backup for special threats.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Since Dragonite is Dragon/Flying, Earthquake would be useless against it, but Stone Edge and Dragon Claw both hit for super effective damage. I should also factor in that Dragonite might have Multiscale, which halves damage while at full HP.

Comparing options, Stone Edge has 80% accuracy with a high crit chance while Dragon Claw is 100% accurate for the same 2x multiplier—crits don't bypass Multiscale anyway, so reliability wins out. I'll go with Dragon Claw.

decisions.thought: Garchomp fell to Dragonite's Outrage. Dragonite is at full HP, so Multiscale may still be active. Gholdengo (Life Orb, full HP) is faster than Dragonite's 90-145 Speed range and resists nothing special, but it survives one Outrage. Plan: switch in Gholdengo, then Thunderbolt Dragonite (2x on Flying). Keep Incineroar (65%) in reserve for Parting Shot or Flare Blitz. Watch for Weavile (fast Ice/Dark, which would hit Gholdengo's Dragon-free side hard) and Rotom-Wash (Levitate blocks Ground, so Gholdengo's Electric is not needed for it).
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Dragonite is at full health with Outrage already knocking out Garchomp, since Garchomp is doubly weak to Dragon. Now I'm weighing whether to bring in Gholdengo or Incineroar to handle it, given Incineroar is down to 132/202 and Gholdengo still has its Life Orb boost at full health.

Thunderbolt from Gholdengo hits Dragonite for solid super-effective damage against its Flying typing, while Dragonite's Outrage back at Gholdengo isn't STAB and would land against a sturdy 115 Defense stat, likely leaving it in decent shape. Gholdengo also outspeeds, so switching it in looks like the better play over Incineroar, whose Fake Out value is already spent.

decisions.hidden_reasoning:
I'm comparing Gholdengo's options against Dragonite: Thunderbolt gets a boost from its Flying typing while Shadow Ball and Make It Rain stay neutral, and I'm weighing whether Multiscale is still active to halve incoming damage at full HP.

Thunderbolt and Make It Rain end up roughly equal in effective damage, but Make It Rain drops Gholdengo's Special Attack by two stages, so Thunderbolt is the safer pick with no stat cost and a chance to paralyze.

decisions.thought: Only Incineroar (132/202) is left. Dragonite is at 31% with Atk -1, and it outspeeds me. Its Outrage should leave me alive (about 84 damage estimated). Flare Blitz is resisted but should KO it. Parting Shot is pointless with no switch-in. After this, the opponent has Rotom-Wash, Weavile and possibly Incineroar unseen.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
I'm checking the matchup: Dragonite at 31% HP with an attack drop from Intimidate, while Incineroar sits at 132/202. Outrage should hit Incineroar hard, but Flare Blitz from Incineroar is resisted by Dragonite's typing, so it shouldn't be enough to finish it off.

Speed-wise, Dragonite outpaces Incineroar, so Outrage lands first — the risk is whether that KOs Incineroar before Flare Blitz even comes into play. Fake Out crossed my mind as a way to buy a turn, but Incineroar's already been out so that option isn't available anymore.

Parting Shot is also moot since there's no one left to switch into — Garchomp and Gholdengo are both down, leaving only Incineroar. That narrows things to Flare Blitz now or Protect to stall out the confusion from Outrage, and I'm running the damage math on Flare Blitz versus Dragonite's Defense to see which option is safer.

That seems like enough to finish Dragonite off, so Flare Blitz is the move to go with.
